features.about: Damage-resistance, critical, healing, life, damage-over-time and nether ratings. Without them every such rating is 0 and its modifier 1.
features.name: ratings

features.about: The 2012 consolidation of the weapon skills: a player's old weapon skill (Axe, Sword, Bow, ...) is read as Heavy, Light, Finesse or Missile Weapons. Without it the old skill is used.
features.name: consolidated_weapon_skills

features.about: The weapon item spells that became auras on the wielder. Without it they are item spells.
features.name: item_spell_auras

features.about: Assessing a player or an unattackable creature shows its armour levels and ratings.
features.name: assessed_armor_and_ratings

features.about: A character may swear allegiance to a patron of lower level.
features.name: swear_to_lower_level

features.about: The pre-order gifts handed out at login, and rare items dropped by creatures.
features.name: pre_order_items_and_rares

features.about: Wielding a second weapon in the off hand.
features.name: dual_wield

features.about: The heritage weapon masteries: a bonus with the heritage's weapon types.
features.name: weapon_masteries

features.about: The augmentation each heritage is born with (Jack of All Trades for the three original heritages, ...).
features.name: innate_augmentations

features.about: Aetheria and its sigil slots.
features.name: aetheria

features.about: Luminance and the luminance auras.
features.name: luminance

features.about: The contract tracker: the quests a character has taken on, with their timers.
features.name: contracts

features.about: Character titles: the titles a character earns and the one it displays.
features.name: titles

features.about: Cloaks, and the cloak slot they are worn in.
features.name: cloaks

features.about: The trinket slot.
features.name: trinkets

features.about: The journal: the quest page, its notebook and the toolbar button that opens it.
features.name: journal

features.about: Secure trade between players: the trade window and its button.
features.name: trade

features.about: Houses: cottages, villas and mansions, bought and rented from their deeds.
features.name: housing

features.about: Apartments, and with them the house recalls and allegiance storage. An era with apartments has housing ([`EraFeatures::implied`]).
features.name: apartments

features.about: Tinkering: the tinkering skills (in place of the appraisal skills), salvaging into salvage bags, and the tinkering recipes that apply salvage to items.
features.name: tinkering

features.about: Cantrips on generated loot.
features.name: cantrips

features.about: Learning a spell by researching its formula, as the early clients' research page did: a formula of carried components tested on a target in magic mode, which casts the spell it makes and teaches it if it is new. It left the game in June 2002, so only Launch enables it by default. A character's own spell formulas (the components each spell takes for its account) are not this system: every era keeps them.
features.name: spell_research

features.about: Chess on the game boards.
features.name: chess

features.about: An oath of allegiance costs unassigned experience once a character has broken from a patron: five percent of its next level's experience, held between 100 and 5,000, a quarter more for each break. Throne of Destiny removed it, so the end of retail does not have it.
features.name: swear_xp_cost

features.about: A minute of invulnerability after resurrecting at a lifestone, given up by teleporting, casting or attacking (May 2000).
features.name: lifestone_protection

features.about: Skill credits left unspent at character creation are kept. Without it they are lost when the character enters the world (November 2002).
features.name: creation_credit_carry_over

features.about: Changing skills after creation: untraining, unspecializing and specializing them with the items that do it (November 2002).
features.name: skill_alteration

features.about: Buying augmentations with experience. The augmentation a heritage is born with is [`EraFeatures::innate_augmentations`].
features.name: augmentations

features.about: PK Lite, the optional lighter player-killer status (September 2003).
features.name: pk_lite

features.about: The `@marketplace` recall (January 2003).
features.name: marketplace_recall

features.about: Strength and Endurance raising a player's natural resistances, health regeneration and stamina savings, and the character sheet's account of them (April 2002).
features.name: endurance_benefits

features.about: `@lifestone` recalls to the lifestone for half the character's mana, and `@die` kills the character. Without it `@lifestone` asks whether to kill the character and does, and there is no `@die` (April 2002).
features.name: lifestone_recall

features.about: `@pkarena` and `@pklarena`, the recalls to the player-killer arenas. `@pklarena` also needs [`EraFeatures::pk_lite`].
features.name: pk_arena_recalls

features.about: A player corpse holding items lasts at least an hour, whatever the character's level (December 2000). Without it the corpse lasts five minutes a level.
features.name: player_corpse_hour_minimum

features.about: Casting skill above a spell's power lowers the chance of burning its components.
features.name: component_burn_skill_discount

features.about: War and Life Magic projectiles can strike critically (August 2002).
features.name: war_and_life_projectile_criticals

features.about: A player's War Magic projectiles do more damage the further their skill exceeds the spell's power (August 2002).
features.name: war_magic_skill_damage_bonus

features.about: A transfer spell whose target cannot take its whole benefit costs its source less (July 2002). Without it the overflow is lost and the source pays in full.
features.name: transfer_overflow_reduces_source

features.about: An item enchantment cast on a creature lands on the items it wears (September 2003), at a higher mana cost for armor (June 2004). Without it item enchantments take an item as their target.
features.name: item_enchantment_redirection

features.about: The spellcasting panel's tabs, which sort a character's spells (May 2000). Without them the panel holds one list.
features.name: spell_tabs

features.about: A fellowship's founder chooses whether it shares experience (December 2000). Without it every fellowship shares.
features.name: fellowship_options

features.about: `@permit` and `@consent`: letting other players loot your corpse (April 2001).
features.name: corpse_permissions

features.about: The corpse's coordinates, told the player after an outdoor death (May 2001).
features.name: corpse_location_notices

features.about: `@log`, copying the chat window to a file (May 2001).
features.name: chat_log

features.about: `@corpse`, which shows where the last outdoor death was (August 2001).
features.name: corpse_command

features.about: The allegiance's message of the day and its broadcasts (June 2001).
features.name: allegiance_messages

features.about: A patron is asked to accept an oath of allegiance (March 2002). Without it an oath is accepted at once.
features.name: allegiance_oath_confirmation

features.about: A patron or monarch booting a member out of the allegiance (April 2002).
features.name: allegiance_boot

features.about: Appraising an item needs no appraisal skill (May 2002). Without it the skill for the item's kind is rolled against the item's difficulty.
features.name: appraisal_without_skills

features.about: A trade note cashes at its face value at any vendor and sells at 15% over it (May 2003). Without it a note sells at 10% over its value and cashes at face value only at the vendor that issued it, at 80% elsewhere.
features.name: trade_notes_cash_anywhere

features.about: Allegiance officers and account bans (May 2004).
features.name: allegiance_officers_and_bans

features.about: Naming the allegiance (May 2006).
features.name: allegiance_name

features.about: A fellowship shares its creatures' loot where its founder chooses to (by September 2001). Without it nobody may loot a fellow's kill as a fellow.
features.name: fellowship_share_loot

features.about: Accepting every fellowship invitation at once, as a character's option (September 2003). Without it every invitation asks.
features.name: fellowship_auto_accept

features.about: A leader opening a fellowship, so that any member may recruit (October 2003).
features.name: fellowship_open

features.about: The allegiance chat room, `@a` and its options (January 2004). The tells to a patron, a monarch and vassals, and the allegiance's broadcasts, are older and do not need it.
features.name: allegiance_chat

features.about: The bonus for a skill trained or specialized at character creation is free experience, worth exactly its 5 or 10 ranks, so the next rank costs what that rank costs on the curve. When it went away is not known. Without it a specialized skill starts with 10 ranks that no experience paid for.
features.name: creation_skill_bonus_as_experience

features.about: The game's own chat rooms: General, Trade, LFG, Roleplay, Society and Olthoi, with the menu entries, options, filters and commands that go with them (September 21, 2005). The allegiance room is older and a Dereth Network room is the network's: neither needs it.
features.name: global_chat_rooms

features.about: A charge on each spell a character knows, spent by casting it and regained over time, that scales what the spell does (removed June 13, 2002).
features.name: spell_charge

features.about: A world-wide value on each spell, spent by everyone casting it and regained over hours, that scales what the spell does and how long it lasts, with a line saying how strong the magic feels and a duration range on the spell panels (removed June 13, 2002).
features.name: spell_economy

features.about: Officer titles, the allegiance lock with its approved vassal, and gagging a member of the allegiance room (May 2006). Also needs [`EraFeatures::allegiance_officers_and_bans`].
features.name: allegiance_titles_and_lock

features.about: `@allegiance house`: opening and closing the monarch's villa or mansion to the allegiance, as guests and for storage (after June 2005). Its storage also needs [`EraFeatures::apartments`].
features.name: allegiance_house_commands
